set.t: 1915 plat shows J. Vejvoda's 80 acres in sec. 23, Bear Lake town; the 1925 papers say silver was buried between the road and the house. Search the strip between the road frontage and the old house site near the SE corner; check the 1938 aerial for the house and driveway. Caveat: the plat is 10 years older than the story, and the papers name him John Vejvoda. Private land: permission needed.

tw-vajvoda-rice-lake-1925.st: Since his wife died in July 1925 he had been digging up money she hid in various spots on the farm; about $6,000 was found, and he was still looking for more.
src: Ely Miner, 16 Oct 1925, p. 8, "Farmer Digs Up $6,000 Wife Buried" (wire; also Mahnomen Pioneer 16 Oct p. 3, River Falls Journal 29 Oct p. 1)
